summary.zh: 用每日有限的交流收益，让“顺路看看朋友”成为路线选择。
summary.en: Limited daily conversation rewards turn checking on friends into a routing decision.

rules.zh: 玩家找到角色并交谈；同一天重复互动通常不会反复刷同样的收益。新台词和关系变化提供反馈，行程时间则是隐形成本。
rules.en: Find a character and talk. Repeating the same interaction usually cannot farm its daily benefit; dialogue and affinity provide feedback while travel consumes time.

decisions.zh: 为了一个人绕远路，还是兼顾几位顺路的朋友？
decisions.en: Detour for one person or visit several nearby friends?

decisions.zh: 把时间留给挣钱，还是维持熟悉的人际关系？
decisions.en: Keep time for income or maintain relationships?

effect.zh: 限一次可抑制刷对话，但需要足够丰富的日常内容。
effect.en: A once-daily limit prevents grinding but needs varied dialogue.

effect.zh: 分散的日程增加路线规划，固定集合点更轻松。
effect.en: Dispersed schedules add routing; gathering places reduce friction.

contrast.zh: 星露谷的维系还涉及衰减例外；波西亚让聊天成为多种日常社交动作中的低成本选项。
contrast.en: Stardew adds maintenance and decay exceptions; Portia places chat among several low-cost daily social actions.

combination.zh: 组合创意：经营送货路线时可顺路拜访老顾客；只在真实完成一次交流后获得关系，不把经过门口当成打卡。
combination.en: Design proposal: a delivery route can include visits to regular customers; affinity requires an actual conversation rather than merely passing a doorway.

setup.zh: 今天只剩一段空闲时间，一位朋友顺路，另一位在较远的码头。
setup.en: One free period remains today; one friend is on your route and another is at a distant dock.

action.zh: 你选择先拜访码头那位，放弃今天多采一次材料。
action.en: Visit the distant friend and skip another gathering trip today.

result.zh: 获得一次交流与新的台词，但当天的生产时间减少了。
result.en: You get a conversation and new dialogue at the cost of production time.

next.zh: 明天根据人物行程重新安排拜访顺序。
next.en: Tomorrow, plan visits around the characters’ schedules again.

firstStep.zh: 做三个有固定行程的角色、一天三个时段与每人每日一次有效交流。
firstStep.en: Use three characters with fixed schedules, three daily periods, and one meaningful daily interaction per person.

pitfall.zh: 如果只是每天点同一句话，关系会变签到；先加入可见的日程或对话变化。
pitfall.en: Repeating identical lines turns relationships into check-ins; add visible schedule or dialogue variation.

test.zh: 观察玩家是否调整自己的路线照顾关系，而非交流收益只靠反复点击。
test.en: See whether players adjust routes for relationships instead of gaining progress through repeated clicking.
